nodes.label: Craft Realtime Bridge (SSE)
nodes.rationale: host-owned in-memory identity-gated realtime channel: workers publish job lifecycle events, browsers consume over SSE at /.craft/events; Craft is a thin bounded pipe, all job intelligence (jobId generation, done-detection, fan-out correlation) stays downstream; M1 is single-instance, backplane deferred

nodes.label: Identity-Gated (userId, jobId) Matrix
nodes.rationale: subscription is the (userId, jobId) pair created only by the publisher under the server-resolved principal, so delivery authorization falls out of identity binding: no per-job auth call, no subscribe endpoint, another user can never receive someone else's frames because no worker publishes under their id

nodes.label: RealtimeBridge.Publish API
nodes.rationale: non-blocking, best-effort, never throws, pure C# so publish never occupies a PowerShell runspace; start/update upsert the current message, end delivers then evicts; oversize data dropped but a small 413 frame still delivered so the frontend gets a visible signal
